subject: general
question: Ammannur Madhava Chakyar was conferred the Padma Shri for his contribution to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kutiyattam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ammannur Madhava Chakyar **was a revered exponent of** Kutiyattam,** a traditional **Sanskrit theatrical art** form originating from **Kerala**.
 
• In recognition of his mastery, he was awarded the **Padma Shri in 1982.** Kutiyattam combines elements of ancient Sanskrit theater with Koothu, an ancient performing art from the Sangam era.
 
• **UNESCO** has honored Kutiyattam as a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity.
 
• Chakyar played a pivotal role in popularizing Kutiyattam by presenting performances in public venues, departing from the tradition of confining them to temple sanctuaries.
 
• Chakyar's contributions to Kutiyattam were widely acclaimed, earning him several accolades including the Padma Bhushan in 2003 and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1979, among others.
 
• He remained deeply dedicated to Kutiyattam throughout his life, abstaining from watching other art forms as he believed it would compromise the purity of his practice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Kuchipudi **is a dance-drama performance originating from the village of Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh, India. It holds the distinction of being one of the eight major classical dances of India, acknowledged by both the Sangeet Natak Akademi and the Ministry of Culture.
 
• **Kathakali,** on the other hand, is a traditional Indian dance form that integrates dance, music, and acting to narrate stories derived from Indian epics and religious scriptures.
 
• **Yakshagana** is a traditional folk dance form characterized by its blend of dance, music, dialogue, costume, make-up, and stagecraft, all executed in a distinctive style and format.
